mn143:15.5: ‘Those worthy of esteem’ (manobhāvanīyā) — bhikkhus regarded as developing and inspiring the mind, i.e. respected teachers.
mn143:19.9: The Comy. explains that this is elsewhere rendered simply ‘the Dhamma’; here ‘dhamma’ paired with ‘sīla’ (virtue) refers to the higher, world-transcending teaching.
